ayahOccurrences.text: إِذْ عُرِضَ عَلَيْهِ بِٱلْعَشِىِّ ٱلصَّٰفِنَٰتُ ٱلْجِيَادُ ٱلْجِيَادُ
ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: إِذْ عُرِضَ عَلَيْهِ بِٱلْعَشِىِّ ٱلصَّٰفِنَٰتُ ٱلْجِيَادُ ٱلْجِيَادُ

lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: ٱلصَّٰفِنَٰتُ is in the derivative form: صَافِنات
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
ص/ف/ن   ṣ–f–n (of horses) to stand on 3 legs with the edge of 1 of the front hoofs just touching the ground (a sign of a thoroughbred), to set the feet side by side, to stand confronting a party of people; to compact dry herbage into a nest; nest, water-skin. Of this root, صَافِنات ṣāfināt, occurs 1 time in the Qur’an
.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
صَافِنات ṣāfināt [pl. of act. part. صَافِنَة ṣāfinatun] (of horses) standing with one leg bent, standing majestically

(38:31) إِذْ عُرِضَ عَلَيْهِ بِالْعَشِيِّ الصَّافِنَاتُ الْجِيَادُ when, at the close of the day, well-bred light-footed horses were paraded before him.
